name: Astronoma
author: John Kerr
description: A local flight log for Omarchy updates: releases crossed, package changes, migrations, warnings, and optional safe agent summaries.

barWidget.description: Shows a rocket in the bar when an update has landed that you have not read yet. Click for the summary, or open the full flight log.

schema.label: Show in bar
schema.description: 'unread' shows the rocket only while an update you have not opened is waiting. 'always' keeps it in the bar permanently.
